<description>
KJ's debug assertions read the mutex futex word and `AtomicRefcounted` refcounts non-atomically. The TSan job builds capnp without optimization, which automatically enables these assertions, and TSan reports these reads as data races the moment KJ objects start communicating across threads.

libmultiprocess enables cross-thread communication for the first time in bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#376, which replaces the pipe used in `EventLoop::sync()` with `kj::Executor::executeSync()`. This is what triggered the [failure](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/actions/runs/38094008438/job/114336046070?pr=376).

Patches are the upstream commits capnproto/capnproto@b91a6ba7c7 and capnproto/capnproto@cc13c8c45f, which are backports of the v2 fixes in capnproto/capnproto#2781 and capnproto/capnproto#2843 (backport PR: capnproto/capnproto#2855).
</description>

<commits>
6e8e85ddcf depends: fix non-atomic reads in capnp debug assertions

KJ's debug assertions read the mutex futex word and `AtomicRefcounted`
refcounts non-atomically. The TSan job builds capnp without optimization,
which automatically enables these assertions, and TSan reports these reads
as data races the moment KJ objects start communicating across threads.

libmultiprocess enables cross-thread communication for the first time
in https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/376, which replaces
the pipe used in `EventLoop::sync()` with `kj::Executor::executeSync()`.

Patches are the upstream commits
https://github.com/capnproto/capnproto/commit/b91a6ba7c7 and
https://github.com/capnproto/capnproto/commit/cc13c8c45f, which are backports
of the v2 fixes in capnproto/capnproto#2781 and capnproto/capnproto#2843
(https://github.com/capnproto/capnproto/pull/2855).
</commits>

diff --git a/depends/patches/capnp/kj_mutex_atomic_futex_reads.patch b/depends/patches/capnp/kj_mutex_atomic_futex_reads.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..da6dc7c6aa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/depends/patches/capnp/kj_mutex_atomic_futex_reads.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+From cc13c8c45fa25de7872709ca8d2009da8abc7773 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: xyzconstant <263061129+xyzconstant@users.noreply.github.com>
+Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 22:13:18 -0300
+Subject: [PATCH] kj: Fix non-atomic reads of futex state
+
+Backport of capnproto/capnproto#2843 from v2 to 1.x.
+
+Uses __atomic_load_n because kj/atomic.h (#2780) is not available on 1.x.
+---
+ c++/src/kj/mutex.c++ | 13 ++++++++-----
+ 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/c++/src/kj/mutex.c++ b/c++/src/kj/mutex.c++
+index edccdf40..68d01935 100644
+--- a/c++/src/kj/mutex.c++
++++ b/c++/src/kj/mutex.c++
+@@ -345,7 +345,8 @@ bool Mutex::lock(Exclusivity exclusivity, Maybe<Duration> timeout, LockSourceLoc
+ void Mutex::unlock(Exclusivity exclusivity, Waiter* waiterToSkip) {
+   switch (exclusivity) {
+     case EXCLUSIVE: {
+-      KJ_DASSERT(futex & EXCLUSIVE_HELD, "Unlocked a mutex that wasn't locked.");
++      KJ_DASSERT(__atomic_load_n(&futex, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & EXCLUSIVE_HELD,
++          "Unlocked a mutex that wasn't locked.");
+ 
+ #ifdef KJ_CONTENTION_WARNING_THRESHOLD
+       auto acquiredLocation = releasingExclusive();
+@@ -427,7 +428,8 @@ void Mutex::unlock(Exclusivity exclusivity, Waiter* waiterToSkip) {
+     }
+ 
+     case SHARED: {
+-      KJ_DASSERT(futex & SHARED_COUNT_MASK, "Unshared a mutex that wasn't shared.");
++      KJ_DASSERT(__atomic_load_n(&futex, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & SHARED_COUNT_MASK,
++          "Unshared a mutex that wasn't shared.");
+       uint state = __atomic_sub_fetch(&futex, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
+ 
+       // The only case where anyone is waiting is if EXCLUSIVE_REQUESTED is set, and the only time
+@@ -446,13 +448,14 @@ void Mutex::unlock(Exclusivity exclusivity, Waiter* waiterToSkip) {
+ }
+ 
+ void Mutex::assertLockedByCaller(Exclusivity exclusivity) const {
++  // Contenders can update the futex even while the caller holds the lock.
+   switch (exclusivity) {
+     case EXCLUSIVE:
+-      KJ_ASSERT(futex & EXCLUSIVE_HELD,
++      KJ_ASSERT(__atomic_load_n(&futex, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & EXCLUSIVE_HELD,
+                 "Tried to call getAlreadyLocked*() but lock is not held.");
+       break;
+     case SHARED:
+-      KJ_ASSERT(futex & SHARED_COUNT_MASK,
++      KJ_ASSERT(__atomic_load_n(&futex, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & SHARED_COUNT_MASK,
+                 "Tried to call getAlreadyLocked*() but lock is not held.");
+       break;
+   }
+@@ -568,7 +571,7 @@ void Mutex::induceSpuriousWakeupForTest() {
+ 
+ uint Mutex::numReadersWaitingForTest() const {
+   assertLockedByCaller(EXCLUSIVE);
+-  return futex & SHARED_COUNT_MASK;
++  return __atomic_load_n(&futex, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) & SHARED_COUNT_MASK;
+ }
+ 
+ void Once::runOnce(Initializer& init, LockSourceLocationArg location) {
+-- 
+2.54.0 (Apple Git-157)
+
diff --git a/depends/patches/capnp/kj_atomicaddref_atomic_read.patch b/depends/patches/capnp/kj_atomicaddref_atomic_read.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..453c81c45a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/depends/patches/capnp/kj_atomicaddref_atomic_read.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+From b91a6ba7c7dbe1e5f70fff7660a01d7155404618 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: xyzconstant <263061129+xyzconstant@users.noreply.github.com>
+Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 22:10:44 -0300
+Subject: [PATCH] kj: fix atomicAddRef non-atomic read
+
+Backport of capnproto/capnproto#2781 from v2 to 1.x.
+
+Uses __atomic_load_n (and the MSVC interlocked equivalent) because
+kj/atomic.h (#2780) is not available on 1.x. The "Arc concurrent final
+release is synchronized" test is not included because kj::Arc does not
+exist on 1.x.
+---
+ c++/src/kj/refcount-test.c++ | 31 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
+ c++/src/kj/refcount.h        | 12 ++++++++++--
+ 2 files changed, 41 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/c++/src/kj/refcount-test.c++ b/c++/src/kj/refcount-test.c++
+index c3b39d45..8ea3a2ac 100644
+--- a/c++/src/kj/refcount-test.c++
++++ b/c++/src/kj/refcount-test.c++
+@@ -20,8 +20,12 @@
+ // THE SOFTWARE.
+ 
+ #include "refcount.h"
++#include "thread.h"
+ #include <kj/compat/gtest.h>
+ 
++#include <atomic>
++#include <thread>
++
+ namespace kj {
+ 
+ struct SetTrueInDestructor: public Refcounted {
+@@ -134,4 +138,31 @@ KJ_TEST("RefcountedWrapper") {
+   }
+ }
+ 
++struct AtomicSetTrueInDestructor: public AtomicRefcounted {
++  AtomicSetTrueInDestructor(bool* ptr): ptr(ptr) {}
++  ~AtomicSetTrueInDestructor() { *ptr = true; }
++
++  bool* ptr;
++};
++
++KJ_TEST("atomicAddRef is safe under concurrent reference-count changes") {
++  bool destroyed = false;
++  auto owner = kj::atomicRefcounted<AtomicSetTrueInDestructor>(&destroyed);
++  auto* object = owner.get();
++  std::atomic<bool> start(false);
++
++  auto addRefs = [&]() noexcept {
++    while (!start.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
++      std::this_thread::yield();
++    }
++    for (uint i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) {
++      auto ref = kj::atomicAddRef(*object);
++    }
++  };
++
++  kj::Thread thread1(addRefs);
++  kj::Thread thread2(addRefs);
++  start.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
++}
++
+ }  // namespace kj
+diff --git a/c++/src/kj/refcount.h b/c++/src/kj/refcount.h
+index 03b5234d..722fca3f 100644
+--- a/c++/src/kj/refcount.h
++++ b/c++/src/kj/refcount.h
+@@ -204,6 +204,14 @@ private:
+ 
+   bool addRefWeakInternal() const;
+ 
++  inline bool hasRefs() const {
++#if _MSC_VER && !defined(__clang__)
++    return KJ_MSVC_INTERLOCKED(Or, acq)(&refcount, 0) > 0;
++#else
++    return __atomic_load_n(&refcount, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) > 0;
++#endif
++  }
++
+   void disposeImpl(void* pointer) const override;
+   template <typename T>
+   static kj::Own<T> addRefInternal(T* object);
+@@ -227,14 +235,14 @@ inline kj::Own<T> atomicRefcounted(Params&&... params) {
+ 
+ template <typename T>
+ kj::Own<T> atomicAddRef(T& object) {
+-  KJ_IREQUIRE(object.AtomicRefcounted::refcount > 0,
++  KJ_IREQUIRE(object.AtomicRefcounted::hasRefs(),
+       "Object not allocated with kj::atomicRefcounted().");
+   return AtomicRefcounted::addRefInternal(&object);
+ }
+ 
+ template <typename T>
+ kj::Own<const T> atomicAddRef(const T& object) {
+-  KJ_IREQUIRE(object.AtomicRefcounted::refcount > 0,
++  KJ_IREQUIRE(object.AtomicRefcounted::hasRefs(),
+       "Object not allocated with kj::atomicRefcounted().");
+   return AtomicRefcounted::addRefInternal(&object);
+ }
+-- 
+2.54.0 (Apple Git-157)
+

</patch>
